title: Retire the dead MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS guard + its broken risk_counters injection; fix liveness-watchdog false URGENT
note: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-10-21 ~18:40Z (popup), answer 'Retire it'. The question put: 'The live order path has no cap on how many positions are open at once. The old global cap (MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS) only exists in a legacy order function that nothing calls any more. Each real-money trade is still sized per account by its risk per trade, and a daily-loss guard exists.' Chosen option: 'Delete the dead guard and its broken counter (the log warning goes away). Rely on per-trade risk sizing plus the per-account daily drawdown switch.' Evidence: HEALTH-REVIEW-20261021 (PR #19341, session_01UsQDRwXzoHAQA1zRSAEumt) MEASURED safe_place_order has 0 production callers (src/runtime/orders.py; coordinator.py:977 says the same), and risk_counters logs 'bybit requires apiKey credential' (legacy unsuffixed BYBIT_API_KEY), so CURRENT_OPEN_POSITIONS is never injected. Pipeline items PI-20261021-ZRSAEUMT-0001 (cap) and PI-20261021-ZRSAEUMT-0002 (watchdog counts refused/dry/side-filtered signals as actionable; false URGENT 2026-10-19T14:00Z) ride this row. Scope: remove the MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS check and the counter that cannot authenticate; leave MAX_DAILY_LOSS_USD semantics unchanged unless it shares the dead path (report, do not remove, if so); fix _count_actionable_signals to exclude refused/dry/side-filtered. Tier 2 (src/runtime): data-backed and operator-decided, so hold for a manager merge, then verify the warning stops in the trader log after deploy.

observation.what: After a dispatch that includes a Bybit-client leg on the post-restart trader (9238aaf15, restarted 2026-10-21T21:27:09Z): (a) trader journal shows no inject_runtime_counters line (positive control on the old build: 2026-10-21T15:41:20Z, text: bybit requires "apiKey" credential); (b) that multi_account_dispatched audit row carries accounts_placed; (c) no liveness_watchdog URGENT for a window whose signals were all declined/side-filtered. Merged as 1fb8bf196 (#19375); deployed 2026-10-21T21:27:09Z (trader sha 9238aaf15); NOT yet observed: 0 dispatches between 21:27:09Z and 22:34Z, so absence of the warning is vacuous so far (12813 journal lines read, 0 hits).
observation.how_to_check: scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh "audit_query?since=2026-10-21T21:27:10Z&event=pipeline_result&limit=500" and look for status=multi_account_dispatched rows with accounts_placed; then scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh "journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&lines=20000&since=<dispatch-1m>&until=<dispatch+1m>" and grep inject_runtime_counters. Dispatch cadence measured 2026-10-20..21: 17 dispatches (buy+sell) in about 41h, so allow up to ~12h. If a dispatch lacks accounts_placed, the deploy did not take.
